agentBanner.title: An agent, agency or investor?
agentBanner.text: Publish listings under your own profile, with all your listings in one place, and receive visitors' inquiries directly. Apply with proof of your business; our team reviews every application before your account is created.

publish.title: It goes live
publish.text: Once approved, your listing is published and visitors can contact you directly.

free.question: Is it free to list a property on {brand}?
free.answer: Yes. Creating an account and publishing a listing is free.

agentRequired.question: Do I need to be a real-estate agent to list my property?
agentRequired.answer: No. Private sellers can list their own properties once they verify their email address. Agents, agencies and investors apply separately, with proof of their business.

review.question: How does the review process work?
review.answer: Every listing is checked by our team before it appears publicly. If changes are needed, you'll see the reason and can update and resubmit it.

editPublished.question: Can I edit my listing after it's published?
editPublished.answer: Yes. Price and a few other details update right away. Bigger changes, like the description or photos, are reviewed again before they go live, and your published listing stays visible while that happens.

phonePublic.question: Is my phone number shown to everyone?
phonePublic.answer: You choose whether your phone number is shown on your public profile.

currency.question: Which currencies can I see prices in?
currency.answer: Prices show in EUR or RSD, converted at the official exchange rate; you can switch anytime, and the original listed price is always shown too.

about.metaDescription: Why we built Walls: one place to find, sell or rent out property in Serbia, directly or through a professional.
about.title: Why we built Walls
about.lead: One place for everyone looking for, selling or renting out property in Serbia.

story.problem: Looking for a home in Serbia usually means jumping between sites, wondering whether a listing is still available and who is really behind it. Selling or renting out your own property isn't easier: you either hand it to an agency or try your luck on a classifieds site.
story.solution: We built {brand} so that all of this happens in one place. You can find a property to buy or rent, advertise your own property yourself, or work with an agent or agency if you'd rather have a professional handle it. The choice is yours.
story.trust: Because trust matters most when the stakes are this high, our team reviews every listing before it goes live, and approves agents, agencies and investors only after seeing proof of their business.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What personal data Walls collects, why, and what rights you have.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {brand} collects, why we collect it, who sees it and what rights you have.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {brand} ({domain}) is run by a company that is currently being registered in Serbia. Its details will be listed on the contact page once registration is complete. You can reach us at {email}.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
Account details: your name, email address and password (stored only as a secure hash) and, if you add them, your phone number, profile picture and short bio.

Professional account applications (agents, agencies and investors): full name or company name, email address, phone number, account type, agency name (for agents) and the proof files you upload. Proof files are visible only to our administrators.

Listings: the property's details, photos, price and location.

Inquiries: the name, email address, optional phone number and message a visitor sends about a listing.

Contact form messages: your name, email address, subject and message.

Listing views: to count a view once per visitor per day we use a fingerprint of the IP address and browser, made with a key that changes every day. We don't store the IP address itself.

use.title: Why we use it
use.body: To run your account and sign you in; to review and publish listings; to deliver inquiries to advertisers and contact messages to us; to send the emails you need, such as email confirmation, password resets and review outcomes; to keep the platform safe, for example by limiting repeated requests and blocking spam; and to show advertisers how many people viewed their listings.

share.title: Who sees it
share.body:
Public profiles and published listings are visible to everyone. Agents', agencies' and investors' phone numbers are always shown on their profiles; private sellers choose whether to show theirs. An email address is shown only if its owner chooses so, and a property's exact address only if the advertiser chooses so.

Inquiries go only to the advertiser or the agent or agency assigned to the listing, and contact messages only to us. We don't sell personal data.

providers.title: Service providers
providers.body: We use trusted providers to run {brand}: Supabase (database), Render (application server), Netlify (website hosting), Cloudinary (photos and documents) and Resend (email). Maps are shown with OpenStreetMap, which receives your browser's requests for map images. Some providers may process data outside Serbia; the safeguards for that will be described here after legal review.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only the cookies {brand} needs to work: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, and a cookie that remembers whether you view prices in EUR or RSD. We don't use advertising or analytics cookies.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep account data while your account exists. Contact form messages are removed from our systems once they have been delivered to our inbox. Retention periods for other data will be set out here after legal review.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can ask to see the personal data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, restrict or object to its use, and receive it in a portable form. Many details you can change yourself in your dashboard; for anything else, write to {email}.

You can also lodge a complaint with the Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (Poverenik).

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy, we'll publish the new version on this page and update the date at the top.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses {brand} ({domain}). By creating an account or publishing a listing you agree to them.

service.title: What {brand} is
service.body: {brand} is a platform for advertising and finding properties for sale or rent in Serbia. We are not a party to any sale or rental, we don't act as an agent or broker, and we don't handle payments. Agreements are made directly between advertisers and the people who contact them.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You must give accurate details and keep your password safe. A private-seller account becomes active once you confirm your email address. An agent, agency or investor account is created only after we approve an application with proof of your business. You can't choose or change your own role.

listings.title: Listings
listings.body:
You may only advertise properties you own or are authorised to advertise. Listings must be accurate and must not mislead about the property, its price or its location.

Every listing is reviewed before it's published, and important changes are reviewed again. We may reject a listing or ask for changes, and we always tell you why.

You keep the rights to your photos and texts, and allow us to show them on {brand} while the listing is published.

conduct.title: What isn't allowed
conduct.body: Fake or duplicate listings, listings for properties you may not advertise, misleading prices, spam or advertising sent through inquiries or the contact form, collecting other users' data, and anything that breaks the law.

deactivation.title: Account deactivation
deactivation.body: If an account breaks these terms, for example through abuse, our administrators may deactivate it. We always give a reason and tell you by email. While an account is deactivated you can't sign in and its listings are hidden from the site.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.body: Advertisers are responsible for their listings and for what they agree with buyers and tenants. We review listings before publishing them, but we can't guarantee that every detail is correct: check the property and its documents yourself before any agreement. The limits of our liability will be set out here after legal review.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Serbia.

changes.title: Changes and questions
changes.body: If we change these terms, we'll publish the new version on this page and update the date at the top. Questions? Write to {email}.
